name: FullStackBench
intro: FullStack Bench 是字节跳动 Seed Foundation Code Team 提出的双语、多语言全栈代码基准。3,374 道题覆盖 16 种编程语言和 11 个主流应用领域，配有 15,168 个单元测试；SandboxFusion 抽取、合成并执行模型代码，以 Pass@1 评分。
build_method: 多源代码收集, LLM 辅助人工标注, 交叉精炼, 六模型难度投票
language: 中文, 英文；16 种编程语言
task_type: 全栈开发, 代码生成
eval_feature: 双语题面, 多语言代码, 11 个应用领域, SandboxFusion 执行
scale: 3,374 道题, 15,168 个单测, 16 种编程语言
build_method_en: Multi-source code collection, LLM-assisted human annotation, cross-refinement, six-model difficulty voting
eval_feature_en: Bilingual Prompts, Multilingual Code, 11 Application Domains, SandboxFusion Execution
intro_en: FullStack Bench is ByteDance Seed Foundation Code Team's bilingual, multilingual full-stack coding benchmark. Its 3,374 problems span 16 programming languages and 11 mainstream application domains with 15,168 unit tests; SandboxFusion extracts, synthesizes, and executes model code for Pass@1 scoring.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2412.00535v6 Sections 2–3, the official repository bytedance/FullStackBench pinned at commit a3c99a9e93b17b7f3926f0d4fcbf99c8ba42b7e4, and the Hugging Face release ByteDance/FullStackBench pinned at revision 11e2e64dbcd66d3680e5025cb9ad8b3c2275080f. GitHub snippets, code documents/books, XLCoST, and expert-authored domain questions are converted into instructions, reference solutions, language-specific tests, and labels with LLM assistance and human verification. Annotators check difficulty, ambiguity, and solvability, cross-refine each other's work, and resolve disagreement by consensus or senior adjudication. In six-model voting, items all six answer correctly are removed; one correct vote is hard, five correct votes are easy, and two to four are medium. A 500K-question Stack Overflow analysis yields 11 mainstream domains plus Others. The bilingual release contains 1,687 English and 1,687 Chinese records, totaling 3,374 problems across 16 programming languages and 15,168 unit tests. Evaluation uses the problem content as the user prompt with model-default system prompt, temperature 0, and at most 2,048 completion tokens. The pinned official runner loads fsb_en_20241204.jsonl only, so it evaluates 1,687 English records; the 1,687 Chinese records are released but not traversed by that script. For non-Java items, SandboxFusion selects by priority: complete fenced block, then incomplete fenced block, then heuristic extraction, preferring the target language within the highest-priority class. Java takes a separate path that detects all classes, enums, and interfaces, writes them to matching files, and runs JUnit; other languages append predefined tests and execute with the declared language. The runner computes Pass@1 as sum(r.accepted for r in results) / len(results), where accepted means the sandbox evaluation succeeded; it does not divide by the fixed bilingual release size 3,374. The public release does not include original authoring scripts or six-model vote outputs.
